description: This file defines the DetailedPerformanceReviewModel class within the OrangeHRM Performance API Model namespace. It models detailed data for a performance review, including attributes like job title, subunit, review period dates, and overall status, and provides methods to serialize the model to an array form.

classes.name: DetailedPerformanceReviewModel
classes.description: A model class representing detailed information about a performance review, with serialization capabilities and related data attributes as per the API schema.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a PerformanceReview entity and sets up attribute mappings and filters.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model into an array, including fetching the self-review status from the performance review service.
